decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.5% — no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into open slots, and letting existing winners run.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today, with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Without a strong move in either direction, institutional participation and volume tend to be lighter, which is consistent with the modest declines seen across the board. Days like this typically reflect investors digesting recent gains rather than reacting to new information.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅波動，納指下跌0.3%，標普500下跌0.5%，反映市場欠缺明確方向，並非受單一重大事件帶動。在缺乏強烈上落動力的情況下，成交量普遍偏淡，與今日溫和的跌幅相符。這類交易日通常反映投資者在消化早前升幅，而非對新消息作出反應。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to invest when a genuinely strong opportunity appears rather than being deployed just to stay fully invested. On a neutral day like today with cash below the usual deployment threshold, holding that cash in reserve avoids buying into mediocre setups and keeps flexibility for a real risk-on move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留在手的現金，待真正出現強勢機會時才動用，而非為求「滿倉」而勉強買入。像今日這種市況中性、現金未達部署門檻的日子，保留現金可避免買入質素一般的機會，同時為日後真正的風險偏好上升時保留靈活性。
